prompt: Create a high fidelity desktop web application UI design mockup for Ilimmu, a private Genshin Impact companion. Landscape 1536x1024. Actual flat screen, no device frame. Operate mode, clean quiet beautiful compact app like GGArtifact. Deep charcoal navy #10131D canvas, #1B2130 panels, soft warm gold #E3BD73 restrained accents, off-white text, muted slate labels, precise Manrope-like sans UI, elegant understated character headings. Use recognizable full-color Genshin character portraits and weapon/artifact game icons as data thumbnails only, no decorative background art. Left 180px app navigation with Ilimmu name, Characters active, Profile, Weapons, Inventory, Goals, Conflicts, Export. Main heading Characters, subtitle 'Your roster. Your builds.' Search characters, filter Owned / All, element filter, sort Name. No add character button. Each character has an accessible Owned toggle and profile link. One build per character with weapon picker, artifact set picker, Sands / Goblet / Circlet main stat selectors. NO substats, NO weights or 100 numbers, NO DPS/Support selectors, NO on-field/off-field selectors, NO Add Build. Synthetic example content: Furina Hydro Sword Fontaine 5-star owned, level 80; Neuvillette Hydro Catalyst Fontaine 5-star owned level 90; Kaedehara Kazuha Anemo Sword Inazuma 5-star owned level 90; Nahida Dendro Catalyst Sumeru 5-star not owned. Furina weapon Fleuve Cendre Ferryman, artifact Golden Troupe, Sands HP%, Goblet Hydro DMG Bonus, Circlet CRIT Rate. Neuvillette weapon Prototype Amber, artifact Marechaussee Hunter, Sands HP%, Goblet Hydro DMG Bonus, Circlet CRIT DMG. Kazuha Iron Sting, Viridescent Venerer, Elemental Mastery all three slots. Beautiful spacing and readable real labels, low chrome, no metric dashboard. OPTION A: spacious horizontally arranged build rows. Three full character sections visible in main region. Each has portrait 64px and character name, elemental metadata, view profile link and owned toggle across header. Under each header one flat inline equipment row: weapon thumbnail and name, artifact thumbnail and name, then the three stat selectors. Full row hierarchy gives character art and build equal clarity. Small filters sit in single toolbar above rows. One narrow inline open artifact picker anchored beneath Golden Troupe showing two or three options, never obscuring entire screen. Polished production SaaS density, ample breathing room between character sections.
source: Built-in image generation, illustrative composition preview
approval: User selected this image and explicitly requested a more compact and cleaner interpretation, clickable portraits, progression editing, and 4pc or 2pc+2pc artifacts.
